text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama... it is time! Let us begin the
show!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good! We even have your trainer
here to
enjoy our special performance!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This is my punishment for losing our
game of
poker. She had a pretty
impressive win.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I knew my chances when I accepted the
challenge.
So I gotta see this through.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, Nakayamatinus... my dear violet!
Have you
come to overthrow the
Overlord?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Umm... My fellow countryman and
enemy of my
ancestors! I shall defeat
you here and now.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: So be it! Then, by these hands, I must—no! You must first capture the sun!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The sun? Hey, that wasn't in the script.

text_block_list.name: Student Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Haha! This play looks really interesting.
Let's go
watch!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The entire town whispers of
Nakayamatinus's
defeat. Everyone
except... her soul mate!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then, as she departs, she says...

Nakayama, that's your cue!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Siiigh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let those eyes reflect no one but me.

text_block_list.name: Student Spectators
text_block_list.text: Awwwww!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is forced to keep up
with T.M.
Opera O's improvisational
instincts.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama and Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Together, we shall face the beginning of
the end!

text_block_list.name: Student Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their performance ends on a high note
coupled
with a grand applause from the
audience!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's finally over...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Cut it out.
choice_data_list: It was a roaring success, Nakayamatinus.
It was a roaring success, wasn't it, Nakayamatinus?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I just did what was in the script... or
maybe, I can't
really say that with all the
twists and turns you
threw in.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The stage is like a living organism,
always
evolving! But you! You stood in
the midst and
danced with the flux.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You have a real talent for theater!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No, you're just projecting.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's just say I'm used to chaotic affairs.
choice_data_list: She was just that quick to catch on.
That could turn into an unexpected talent.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Competition is all about how quickly you

respond, your perseverance, and your
tact.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how motivational! I've got it! In our
next
performance, we should add a
samba!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have since been reluctant to, as I find
the
challenge unsuitable for newcomers.
But with you,
I have no reason to worry!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh?! Consider me in. I'm always up for a
thrilling
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Don't you start too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, I was just messing around. You
haven't
seen anything yet.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! Those implications! Your future in
the field
appears bright indeed!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're overestimating me here. I've just
seen a
few musicals, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've got someone who likes 'em, so we
watch stuff
together when the docs let
us.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I've said too much.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
See ya later, Opera O. Let's have
another thrilling
competition sometime.
